headerDisplay: This plugin is provided by [nroughol-dev](https://github.com/nroughol-dev/), forked from [nicoduj](https://github.com/nicoduj/)

name.title: Name
name.description: The name that appears in the Homebridge log prefix. Display only — does not affect the platform identifier.

refreshTimer.title: Refresh timer (seconds)
refreshTimer.description: Refresh alarm and smoke sensor states every X seconds (120-3600, default 300). Set to 0 to disable background polling (state will only refresh when the Home app is opened). Minimum 120s to avoid rate limiting by Homiris servers.

eveHistory.title: Enable Eve temperature history (experimental)
eveHistory.description: Expose temperature sensors with a fakegato-history service so the Eve app can render graphs, min/max and weekly summaries. Apple Home is unaffected.

refreshTimerTemperature.title: Temperature refresh timer (seconds)
refreshTimerTemperature.description: Refresh temperature sensors every X seconds (1800-86400, default 7200). The official Homiris app only samples temperature every 2 hours; polling faster increases the risk of API rate limiting. Temperature is also refreshed on demand when the Home app reads the sensors. Set to 0 to disable.

maxWaitTimeForOperation.title: Maximum wait time during operation
maxWaitTimeForOperation.description: Set the maximum time that we wait for security system operation to complete. When elapsed, check the current State again and updates accordingly.

refreshTimerDuringOperation.title: Refresh timer during operation
refreshTimerDuringOperation.description: Set the refresh timer during operation in progress to detect the end of the operation.
